scope: Lossless recovery of three previously downloaded exact LG MAIN software images; standard-library wrapper with separately supplied official safe LZO1F library. No vendor updater or phone code executed.

scan.method: Every byte offset; SGS v1/v2/v4/v36; plain and XOR-A5; bounded header, entry, variable and complete resource validation.
limits: Candidate requires nonzero START, at least one variable and resource, and at least 16 bytecode bytes; this is a conservative game scan.
Unknown proprietary packing and native ARM games are not ruled out.
Extraction preserves original bytes through the declared resource end, with a recognized 32-byte wrapper; unknown appended data is not guessed.
A structurally valid extraction is not proof that the game is playable.

unconfirmedCandidates.status: Unconfirmed structural coincidence in a monotone signed-value table; not an identified SGS application or exported game.

limits: Nine program extents per image are bounded and finish at exact EOF; original alignment anomalies are preserved, not repaired or declared ELF-ABI-conformant.
No full phone boot, GNEX interpreter discovery, native game execution or new retail SGS is established.
Plain/XOR SGS scan does not rule out other packaging; the sole structural candidate is unconfirmed.
The separate SV360/SD910 NAND trial only tested two known layouts and found no ELF magic; it does not establish absence of code or games.
